name: prayer-times
description: The current prayer and how long is left, the next prayer, and zawal, above the prompt. Computed on your computer from your location; nothing is sent anywhere.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Your latitude in degrees, north positive (e.g. 51.51). Stays in your local settings.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Your longitude in degrees, east positive (e.g. -0.13). Stays in your local settings.

method.title: Fajr and Isha convention
method.description: karachi 18°/18°, mwl 18°/17°, isna 15°/15°, egypt 19.5°/17.5°, makkah 18.5° and Isha 90 min after Maghrib.

asr.title: Asr
asr.description: hanafi: shadow twice an object's length. standard (Shafi'i, Maliki, Hanbali): shadow equal to it.

highLatitude.title: Far north or south
highLatitude.description: When the sun never gets low enough for Fajr or Isha: angle (a share of the night by the angle), seventh (a seventh of the night) or middle (half the night).

adjust.title: Minutes to adjust
adjust.description: Shift times to match your mosque's timetable, e.g. `asr+2 isha-5`. Names: fajr, sunrise, dhuhr, asr, maghrib, isha.

makruhMinutes.title: Sunrise and sunset makruh (minutes)
makruhMinutes.description: How long after sunrise, and before sunset, the line shows a makruh warning.

zawalMinutes.title: Zawal (minutes before Dhuhr)
zawalMinutes.description: How long before the sun's highest point the line shows zawal.

warnMinutes.title: Warn before a prayer ends (minutes)
warnMinutes.description: A toast when this many minutes are left to pray the current prayer, once per prayer. 0 turns it off.

toasts.title: Prayer toasts
toasts.description: A toast when each prayer time begins, saying until when it lasts, and one before it ends. Off turns off both.
